name: BatchSubmission
story: As a reviewer, I want to inspect exactly which proposals were submitted in a particular version, so that I can compare edits before review.

mcp.description: Read the original proposals, author and time of one submitted batch version.

name: ChangeBatch
story: As an agent, I want to inspect a change batch with its proposed records and evidence, so that I can explain suggestions, check decisions and help a member correct inaccurate projects.
query:
query ChangeBatch($id: ID!, $refs: [String!]) {
  changeBatch(id: $id) {
    id
    title
    purpose
    source
    state
    policy
    anchors
    validation
    summary
    reviewBy
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    expiresAt
    counts
    questions
    review
    reviewRun
    instructions {
      code
      itemKey
      actor
      required
      message
      taskId
      url
    }
    operations(refs: $refs) {
      ref
      state
      operation
      evidence
      confidence
      reason
      decision
      record
      recordRevision
    }
  }
}

name: ChangeBatchChanges
story: As an authorized caller, I want to apply changebatch changes using explicit actions, so that each change has a durable receipt and explicit next steps.

mcp.description: When asked to submit proposals or amend an existing submission, use MutateBatchSubmission. The steward may approve clean proposals automatically under this installation’s settings. Use this operation to stage drafts, configure draft anchors, ask questions or review on a member’s authority. To request changes, review with verdict request_changes, expectedVersion and a comment. Questions go on the batch with `ask`, never as records. A follow-up nothing in the batch depends on is a Planning issue. Before staging, read the types. If three or more records share a shape no type names (an order, a duration, a stage, the same parent), propose the type and its relationship types in the same batch, with endpoints. Document is for prose, not records. Propose a type only when several records share a shape someone will query by; prefer one type with a property over several near-identical types. Cards: summary says what it is and why this organization cares; body only for content beyond the summary; no boilerplate repeated across cards; reason says why this record; an evidence quote is the supporting sentence. Read advice in the receipt and review on the batch (ChangeBatches with details) before submitting.

name: ChangeBatches
story: As an agent, I want to search saved change batches and their review state, so that I can resume work without loading every proposal.
query:
query ChangeBatches($ids: [ID!], $search: String, $state: [String!], $first: Int = 20, $after: String, $details: Boolean = false, $refs: [String!]) {
  changeBatches(
    ids: $ids
    search: $search
    state: $state
    first: $first
    after: $after
  ) {
    nodes {
      id
      submittedVersion
      title
      state
      counts
      reviewBy
      reviewUrl
      questions @include(if: $details)
      instructions @include(if: $details) {
        code
        itemKey
        actor
        required
        message
        taskId
        url
      }
      advice @include(if: $details)
      review @include(if: $details)
      changeRequests @include(if: $details)
      reviewRun @include(if: $details)
      operations(refs: $refs) @include(if: $details) {
        ref
        state
        operation
        evidence
        confidence
        reason
        decision
        record
        recordRevision
      }
    }
    pageInfo {
      hasNextPage
      endCursor
    }
  }
}

name: Explorations

name: MutateBatchSubmission
story: As an agent or member, I want to submit new proposals or amend pending ones in one mutation, so that the proposal version and review are recorded together.
query:
mutation MutateBatchSubmission($input: MutateBatchSubmissionInput!) {
  mutateBatchSubmission(input: $input) {
    id
    title
    submittedVersion
    state
    counts
    reviewRefs
    reviewUrl
    reviewRun
    instructions {
      code
      itemKey
      actor
      required
      message
      taskId
      url
    }
  }
}

mcp.description: Create and submit with requestKey, title and proposals. Edit with requestKey, batchId, expectedVersion, replacement or new proposals keyed by ref, and/or refs to withdraw in remove. Delete an open draft with requestKey, batchId, expectedVersion:0 and deleteBatch:true. Retry identical inputs with the original requestKey. Minimal proposal `{operation:{operation:"create",type:"graph-node",ref:"$person",attributes:{typeId:"Person",title:"Ada"}}}`.

requestKey.description: Stable idempotency key. Retry a lost response with identical inputs and the same key.

batchId.description: Existing batch ID, or a caller-chosen UUID for a new batch. Omit to generate an ID.

expectedVersion.description: Required for existing batches. Use 0 for an open draft or a legacy batch without a recorded submission.

anchors.description: Node addresses, such as Organization:sunny, every node the batch creates must connect to, along any path of saved or staged edges; submit is refused otherwise. Omit to anchor to the root: the organization's Organization node, or the owner's Person in a personal graph. In a batch that commits by policy, records that reach no anchor wait for a member instead. An empty list removes the requirement.

deleteBatch.description: Discard an open draft. Pass batchId, expectedVersion and requestKey only.

name: MutateExploration
story: As an agent or member, I want to open, close and hide parts of an exploration with one merge patch, so that the page and every agent see the same view change at once.

mcp.description: Open paths (offerings, products, projects, competitors, issues, repositories, open pullRequests or any edge type), hide nodes or start an exploration with a merge patch; the explore page updates live. Writes no records.

name: MutateShare

mcp.description: Editors: show another organization part of this graph (a KnowledgeGraph from roots, minus hidden nodes) with a merge patch, or archive the share.

name: Ontology

name: OntoSettings

name: RemoveStagedChanges

name: ReviseBatch

name: SaveSettings

name: Share

name: Shares

mcp.description: List what this graph shows other organizations: each share's KnowledgeGraph, roots and hidden nodes.

name: StageChanges

name: StageCreativeRecord

name: SubmitBatch
